summary: Captures the current UTC system time as a FILETIME, folds its two 32-bit halves into a single 64-bit tick value via Allmul, stores that tick to global qword_8D3EC0, and returns it. Straight-line; no conditional branches.

operations.description: Call the imported GetSystemTimeAsFileTime with a stack FILETIME buffer to capture the current UTC system time.
Use Allmul, the 64-bit multiply helper, to multiply the high 32-bit FILETIME word by 0x100000000 so it lands in the upper half of the 64-bit tick.
Combine the tick as the low FILETIME dword plus the shifted high dword.
Store the resulting 64-bit tick to global qword_8D3EC0 (0x008D3EC0).
The upper dword of the stored qword covers the overlapping byte at 0x008D3EC4.
